sample.title: How The U.S Became So Dependent On Taylor Farms
sample.description:
Taylor Farms has been linked to cyclosporiasis and salmonella outbreaks this summer. After years of consolidation, experts say the company’s ability to control every stage of the supply chain has made it indispensable to grocers and restaurant chains, while raising the stakes for consumers when things go wrong. CNBC food and wellness reporter Brandon Gomez explains how the U.S. became so reliant on Taylor Farms.

More than 600 killed in Nepal flood as search for survivors enters fourth day | BBC News
sample.description:
More than 600 people have died following Wednesday's devastating flash flood in Nepal.
 
At least 2,426 people are missing, Nepal’s disaster management authority says, as rescue operations continue for a fourth day.
 
Families of the missing - including at least 517 foreign nationals - are waiting for news on the whereabouts of their loved ones.
 
Emergency teams are warning that rain is making it difficult to reach some of the worst-affected areas.
